lead.zh: 隔夜焦点：黄仁勋辞任英伟达CEO，CFO克雷斯临时接棒；普京会见美国特使未见突破；霍尔木兹油轮起火推高油价。
lead.en: Overnight: Jensen Huang quit as Nvidia CEO with CFO Colette Kress as interim chief; Putin met U.S. envoys without a breakthrough; tanker fires in Hormuz lifted oil.

title.zh: 黄仁勋辞任英伟达CEO，CFO克雷斯临时接棒
title.en: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO; CFO Colette Kress named interim chief

summary.zh: 英伟达11月12日宣布，董事会已接受黄仁勋辞去总裁、CEO及董事职务，即刻生效。CFO科莱特·克雷斯出任临时CEO，前新思科技CEO哈维·琼斯成为公司首任董事会主席。股价收跌4.3%。
summary.en: Nvidia said on Nov 12 that its board accepted Jensen Huang's resignation as president, CEO and director, effective immediately. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and ex-Synopsys chief Harvey Jones becomes the first board chair. Shares closed down 4.3%.

body.zh:
英伟达向美国证交会提交的文件显示，董事会于11月11日接受黄仁勋辞职，次日对外公布。这位联合创始人执掌公司逾三十年，此前因与一名被美国情报部门怀疑为中国间谍的女子有婚外情而陷入危机，《纽约时报》另报道他与下属高管存在恋情。

- 临时CEO克雷斯自2013年起任CFO，将继续兼任CFO；董事会将在内外部候选人中遴选正式CEO。路透称，CUDA核心开发者伊恩·巴克被视为潜在长期人选。
- 股价盘中一度大跌约13%，收跌4.3%至166.19美元；AMD、博通各涨约6%。
- 参议员沃伦表示，黄仁勋离任并不能免除公司在出口管制合规方面对国会的说明义务。
- 英伟达仍将于美西时间11月17日公布第三财季业绩，克雷斯在内部信中称将于11月18日召开员工大会。

来源：[英伟达新闻稿](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)、[路透/Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-to-step-down-in-big-blow-to-ai-boom-5021980)、[CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns/)。
body.en:
An SEC filing shows the board accepted Huang's resignation on Nov 11; it was announced the next day. The co-founder had led Nvidia for more than three decades before an affair with a woman U.S. intelligence suspects of spying for China, plus a New York Times report of a relationship with a subordinate executive, plunged the company into crisis.

- Interim CEO Kress, CFO since 2013, keeps the CFO role; the board will weigh internal and external candidates. Reuters says CUDA veteran Ian Buck is seen as a possible longer-term pick.
- Shares fell as much as about 13% intraday and closed down 4.3% at $166.19; AMD and Broadcom each rose about 6%.
- Sen. Elizabeth Warren said his exit does not absolve Nvidia of answering Congress on export-control compliance.
- Q3 results are still due Nov 17 (PT); Kress told staff an all-hands is set for Nov 18.

Sources: [Nvidia newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition), [Reuters via Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-to-step-down-in-big-blow-to-ai-boom-5021980), [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns/).

title.zh: 谷歌发布Gemini 4 Hydrogen，主打快速编程与智能体任务
title.en: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen for fast coding and agentic work

summary.zh: 谷歌11月12日推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，定位于日常编程和智能体工作流的快速模型，向AI Studio、Gemini API、Gemini应用及谷歌搜索全面开放；百万token上下文统一定价为每百万输入1.5美元、输出7.5美元。
summary.en: Google introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen on Nov 12, a fast model for everyday coding and agent workflows, rolling out across AI Studio, the Gemini API, the Gemini app and Search. It is priced flat across a 1M-token context at $1.50 input and $7.50 output per million tokens.

body.en:
Google says Hydrogen scores 51 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its default high thinking level, edging its frontier Gemini 4 Argon (50), and 54 at the xhigh setting, while finishing tasks faster than peers. Gemini 4 Carbon and Argon remain the long-horizon reasoning models.

Source: [Google blog](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/introducing-gemini-4-hydrogen/).

title.zh: 百度推出大模型交易平台“词元所”；张一鸣称字节最早2029年追平前沿
title.en: Baidu launches model-token exchange; Zhang Yiming says ByteDance may catch frontier labs by 2029

summary.zh: 百度世界2026大会上，李彦宏发布大模型交易平台“词元所”，主打模型验真与征信，上线一个月日均调用超5000万次。另据钛媒体，张一鸣内部表示字节最早2029或2030年才能追平OpenAI和Anthropic。
summary.en: At Baidu World 2026, Robin Li launched a model-token marketplace focused on verifying models and rating providers, already handling over 50 million calls a day. TMTPost reported Zhang Yiming told staff ByteDance may match OpenAI and Anthropic by 2029 or 2030 at the earliest.

body.zh:
据钛媒体，词元所通过模型指纹比对、能力与性能测试核验资源，并以定期抽检和全链路监测为提供商建立信用评级；上线一个月入驻资源超100个，日均调用Token超7000亿。

同日报道称，张一鸣在面向AI团队的全员会上坦言，字节Seed系列模型的预训练数据规模仍落后于海外顶尖公司，这是当前最需关注的问题。

来源：[钛媒体](https://www.tmtpost.com/8203507.html)。

title.zh: 普京会见威特科夫与库什纳，俄方称会谈“建设性”但未见突破
title.en: Putin meets Witkoff and Kushner; Kremlin calls talks constructive, no breakthrough

summary.zh: 美国特使威特科夫和库什纳12日在克里姆林宫会见普京。俄总统助理乌沙科夫称会谈坦率、富有成效，双方同意继续三方谈判并推进更大规模换俘；但俄方拒绝“灰色地带”和外国维和部队。两人随后赴都柏林见泽连斯基。
summary.en: Witkoff and Kushner met Putin in the Kremlin on Nov 12. Aide Yury Ushakov called it productive: both sides will keep up trilateral talks and pursue a bigger prisoner swap, but Moscow rejected grey zones and foreign peacekeepers. The envoys then met Zelensky in Dublin.

body.en:
According to the Kremlin readout, Putin proposed a humanitarian operation around Konstantinovka with demining and international observation, and Moscow backed a long-term European security framework. CNA, citing the talks, said Putin signalled no compromise on core Ukraine demands. Separately, Zelensky said Starlink service in Ukraine had shown serious anomalies along the front in recent days.

Sources: [Kremlin](https://en.kremlin.ru/events/president/news/81252), [AP](https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-putin-kushner-witkoff-683810203340077f33611fd1d1757b23), [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/putin-russia-ukraine-war-deal-us-talks-6547041).

title.zh: 霍尔木兹两艘油轮起火；特朗普称“不需要与伊朗达成协议”
title.en: Two tankers burn in Hormuz as Trump says 'We don't need a deal with Iran'

summary.zh: 伊朗革命卫队称，两艘载油逾400万桶的油轮在霍尔木兹海峡一条“未经授权航线”上因“事故”起火。特朗普随后发文称美国不需要与伊朗达成协议，市场担忧美伊战争延长，布伦特原油当日涨逾3%至约95.8美元。
summary.en: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said two tankers carrying more than 4 million barrels caught fire after an 'accident' on an unauthorised route in the Strait of Hormuz. Trump then posted that the U.S. doesn't need a deal with Iran, and Brent rose more than 3% to about $95.8.

body.en:
Tehran has restricted Hormuz traffic to routes it approves since the regional war began in late February. The Wall Street Journal reported that Vice President JD Vance is weighing face-to-face talks with Iranian security chief Mohsen Rezaei, though officials called that preliminary. Saudi Arabia also said debris from two intercepted ballistic missiles fell in the Mecca region.

Sources: [The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/news/the-hindu-top-news-of-the-day-november-12-2026/article71693747.ece), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/stock-market-today-live-updates.html), [Just Security](https://www.justsecurity.org/164226/early-edition-november-12-2026/).

title.zh: 科洛姆赢得密西西比参议员选举，民主党参院多数扩至55席
title.en: Scott Colom wins Mississippi Senate race, widening Democrats' majority to 55

summary.zh: 民主党人斯科特·科洛姆以微弱优势击败共和党现任参议员海德-史密斯，成为密西西比州自1982年以来首位民主党参议员、重建时期以来首位非裔参议员，民主党参院多数扩大到55席。
summary.en: Democrat Scott Colom narrowly beat Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith, becoming Mississippi's first Democratic senator since 1982 and its first Black senator since Reconstruction. Democrats' Senate majority grows to 55.

title.zh: 美股小幅收低：英伟达换帅与油价上涨拖累，AMD、博通逆势大涨
title.en: Wall Street dips as Nvidia shake-up and oil jump weigh; AMD and Broadcom rally

summary.zh: 11月12日道指跌0.4%至52297点，标普500跌0.4%至7592点，纳指跌0.4%至25366点。英伟达收跌4.3%，AMD、博通涨近6%；布伦特原油涨逾3%，黄金期货跌约3%。三大指数本周仍有望录得8月以来最佳周涨幅。
summary.en: On Nov 12 the Dow fell 0.4% to 52,297, the S&P 500 0.4% to 7,592 and the Nasdaq 0.4% to 25,366. Nvidia lost 4.3% while AMD and Broadcom gained nearly 6%; Brent rose over 3% and gold futures fell about 3%. Indexes are still on pace for their best week since August.

body.en:
The S&P 500 erased an early drop of nearly 1% before finishing modestly lower. Super Micro fell 11.3% and Corteva 24.3%. U.S. futures edged higher in the evening; October PPI is due Friday, with economists polled by Dow Jones expecting a 0.4% monthly rise.

Sources: [AP](https://apnews.com/article/wall-street-stocks-dow-nasdaq-3f3668a937a11535103e3a5c8d82c9fc), [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-stocks-lower-at-close-of-trade-dow-jones-industrial-average-down-036-5023324), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/stock-market-today-live-updates.html).

title.zh: 中芯国际三季度净利润28.47亿元，同比增长87.6%
title.en: SMIC Q3 net profit rises 87.6% to 2.85 billion yuan

summary.zh: 中芯国际公告，第三季度营收219.83亿元，同比增长28.1%；归母净利润28.47亿元，同比增长87.6%。前三季度净利润73.14亿元，同比增长91.6%，主要得益于晶圆销量增加和产能利用率上升。
summary.en: SMIC reported Q3 revenue of 21.98 billion yuan, up 28.1%, and net profit of 2.85 billion yuan, up 87.6%. Nine-month profit rose 91.6% to 7.31 billion yuan on higher wafer shipments and utilisation.

title.zh: 德国机器人公司Agile Robots融资5亿美元，估值85亿美元
title.en: Germany's Agile Robots raises $500 million at $8.5 billion valuation

summary.zh: 慕尼黑人形机器人与机械臂制造商Agile Robots宣布完成5亿美元融资，软银领投，英伟达和日立参投，估值达85亿美元，资金将用于拓展美国市场和扩充产能。
summary.en: Munich-based humanoid and robot-arm maker Agile Robots said it raised $500 million led by SoftBank, with Nvidia and Hitachi participating, at an $8.5 billion valuation. It will use the money to expand in the U.S. and add capacity.

title.zh: 习近平在纪念孙中山诞辰160周年大会上讲话，强调推动祖国完全统一
title.en: Xi marks Sun Yat-sen's 160th anniversary, urges reunification

summary.zh: 纪念孙中山先生诞辰160周年大会12日在人民大会堂举行。习近平称孙中山是伟大的民族英雄和民主革命先驱，号召继承其精神推进民族复兴，并表示坚决反对“台独”、推动祖国完全统一。台湾方面拒绝相关主张。
summary.en: At a Nov 12 ceremony in the Great Hall of the People for Sun Yat-sen's 160th birth anniversary, Xi called Sun a great national hero and said Beijing firmly opposes Taiwan independence and will push for reunification. Taiwan rejected the proposal.

body.zh:
习近平在讲话中号召继承孙中山“爱国、为民、求真、奋斗、团结、胸怀天下”的精神，推进强国建设和民族复兴。香港、澳门及台湾各界同日也举行了纪念活动，纪念邮票同步发行。据X平台汇总的报道，台湾当局表示台湾前途只能由2300万台湾人民决定。

来源：[新华网](https://www.news.cn/20261112/5227cc19030e453cb87b4745d5446a1c/c.html)、[人民网](https://politics.people.com.cn/n1/2026/1112/c1024-40832778.html)。

title.zh: 国内首个口服GLP-1减肥药获批上市
title.en: China approves its first oral GLP-1 weight-loss drug

summary.zh: 礼来中国11月12日宣布，穆优达（奥氟格列隆钙片）获国家药监局批准，成为国内首个用于成人体重管理的口服GLP-1受体激动剂，每日一片，服用不受饮食饮水限制。
summary.en: Lilly China said on Nov 12 that regulators approved orforglipron (brand Muyouda) as the country's first oral GLP-1 drug for adult weight management, taken once daily without food or water restrictions.

title.zh: 国内汽柴油价格每吨分别下调645元、625元
title.en: China cuts gasoline and diesel prices by 645 and 625 yuan a ton

summary.zh: 国家发改委宣布，自11月12日24时起，国内汽、柴油（标准品）价格每吨分别下调645元和625元，原因是调价周期内国际原油均价低于上一周期。
summary.en: China's NDRC said gasoline and diesel prices would fall by 645 and 625 yuan per ton from midnight Nov 12, as average international crude prices in the window were lower than in the prior cycle.

title.zh: 英伟达风波延烧：卢特尼克、黄仁勋被请赴参院作证
title.en: Nvidia fallout widens: Lutnick and Huang asked to testify in Senate

summary.zh: 美参院银行委员会主席蒂姆·斯科特致函商务部长卢特尼克和前英伟达CEO黄仁勋，分别请其于12月10日和12月3日出席听证；NBC称卢特尼克已同意。众议院议长约翰逊称国会正形成限制对华芯片出口的共识。
summary.en: Senate Banking chair Tim Scott asked Commerce Secretary Lutnick and ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to testify on Dec 10 and Dec 3; NBC says Lutnick agreed. House Speaker Johnson says Congress is converging on tighter chip-export limits to China.

body.zh:
据CNBC援引NBC报道，参议院银行委员会主席蒂姆·斯科特周四晚间致函两人：请黄仁勋12月3日出席听证，请商务部长卢特尼克12月10日就商务部对英伟达对华出口的监管与执法作证，卢特尼克已同意自愿出席。

- 焦点在于新加坡公司Megaspeed：黄仁勋承认与该公司一名高管有婚外情，而Megaspeed过去两年购入逾48亿美元英伟达先进AI芯片，议员关注芯片是否经其马来西亚子公司流向中国。
- 众议院议长迈克·约翰逊表示，黄仁勋辞职后，国会在限制对华芯片出口上的共识正在扩大，两党议员近一周均呼吁收紧管制。
- 市场方面，英伟达周五美股盘前小幅上涨约1.8%（美东时间早5点），此前周四盘中一度大跌后收跌逾4%；该股近一个月已累计下跌超20%。

来源：[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/nvidia-scandal-lutnick-chip-sales.html)、[卫报直播](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/live/2026/nov/13/nvidia-jensen-huang-to-testify-before-congress-live-latest-updates)。
body.en:
Citing NBC, CNBC reports Senate Banking chair Tim Scott wrote to both men on Thursday evening, asking Huang to appear on Dec 3 and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick on Dec 10 about Commerce's oversight and enforcement of Nvidia exports to China. Lutnick has agreed to appear voluntarily.

- The focus is Singapore-based Megaspeed: Huang acknowledged an affair with one of its executives, and the firm bought more than $4.8 billion of advanced Nvidia AI chips over two years. Lawmakers are probing possible diversion via its Malaysian subsidiary.
- House Speaker Mike Johnson said a consensus on limiting chip exports to China is growing in Congress after Huang's exit; members of both parties have called for tighter curbs this week.
- Nvidia was about 1.8% higher in premarket trading at 5 a.m. ET Friday, after a volatile Thursday that ended just over 4% lower; the stock is down more than 20% over the past month.

Sources: [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/nvidia-scandal-lutnick-chip-sales.html), [The Guardian live blog](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/live/2026/nov/13/nvidia-jensen-huang-to-testify-before-congress-live-latest-updates).

title.zh: 路透：中国逾32亿美元AI算力项目依赖受限英伟达芯片
title.en: Reuters: $3.2 billion of Chinese AI projects rely on restricted Nvidia chips

summary.zh: 路透审阅150余份采购公告与投资文件发现，中国各地有总值逾230亿元人民币的算力项目围绕H100、H200、H800等受限芯片设计；黄仁勋离任与美方加强审查令这些项目面临延误或改用国产芯片的风险。
summary.en: A Reuters review of 150-plus procurement and investment documents found Chinese computing projects worth over 23 billion yuan built around restricted H100, H200 and H800 chips; Huang's exit and tighter U.S. scrutiny put them at risk of delays or redesigns.

title.zh: 非营利组织起诉五大AI公司，要求冻结新模型研发
title.en: Nonprofits sue five AI labs to freeze development of new models

summary.zh: Public Citizen等四家非营利组织在旧金山高等法院起诉OpenAI、Anthropic、谷歌、Meta和SpaceX，援引企业自身对极端风险的警告，请求法院禁止其开发或部署能力更强的新模型。
summary.en: Four nonprofits including Public Citizen sued OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceX in San Francisco Superior Court, citing the labs' own extreme-risk warnings and asking a judge to bar them from building or deploying more capable models.

title.zh: 特朗普撤下万斯伊朗谈判角色，称盟友受威胁可能动武
title.en: Trump pulls Vance off Iran talks, says force possible if allies threatened

summary.zh: 特朗普要求副总统万斯转而专注国内事务，称与伊朗达成协议的日子“早已过去”，并表示若美国盟友和船只受威胁可能“立即”对伊动武。分析称美伊陷入“不战不谈”僵局，油价与美债收益率随之走高。
summary.en: Trump told VP Vance to focus on domestic issues, said the days of needing an Iran deal 'have long since passed', and warned he may use force 'right now' if U.S. allies or ships are threatened. Oil and Treasury yields rose on the 'no war, no talks' standoff.

title.zh: 泽连斯基：俄乌将进行迄今最大规模换俘
title.en: Zelensky says Russia-Ukraine prisoner swap will be the largest yet

summary.zh: 泽连斯基在都柏林会见美国特使威特科夫和库什纳后表示，俄方已同意换俘，规模将为开战以来最大，是谈判的“实际成果”。欧盟称正筹备第22轮对俄制裁，并将在11月26日至27日特别峰会讨论乌克兰2027年融资。
summary.en: After meeting U.S. envoys Witkoff and Kushner in Dublin, Zelensky said Russia agreed to a prisoner exchange that will be the largest of the war, a 'real result' of talks. The EU is preparing a 22nd sanctions package and will discuss Ukraine's 2027 funding at a Nov 26-27 summit.

title.zh: 以军空袭加沙纳赛尔医院，至少6人死亡
title.en: Israeli strike on Gaza's Nasser hospital kills at least six

summary.zh: 以色列周四空袭加沙南部汗尤尼斯纳赛尔医疗中心外科楼层，至少6人死亡、约30人受伤，以军称目标为哈马斯指挥官。当天加沙多地袭击共致11人死亡；53个国家和组织呼吁以方允许人道物资畅通进入。
summary.en: An Israeli strike hit the surgery floor of Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis on Thursday, killing at least six and wounding about 30; Israel said it targeted a Hamas commander. Strikes killed 11 across Gaza that day, and 53 states and bodies urged unimpeded aid access.

title.zh: 亚股周五多数收跌：创业板指跌3.3%，恒指跌1.55%
title.en: Asian stocks mostly fall Friday; ChiNext down 3.3%, Hang Seng 1.55%

summary.zh: 受英伟达换帅、油价走高及美联储加息预期升温拖累，上证指数跌0.59%至3634点，深成指跌2.05%，创业板指跌3.32%；恒指跌1.55%，恒生科技指数跌3%。日经225逆势涨0.53%，录得五个月来最大周涨幅。
summary.en: Nvidia turmoil, higher oil and rising Fed-hike bets weighed on Asia: Shanghai fell 0.59% to 3,634, Shenzhen 2.05% and ChiNext 3.32%; the Hang Seng lost 1.55% and its tech index 3%. Japan's Nikkei rose 0.53%, its best week in five months.

body.zh:
港股方面，AI模型股智谱（Z.AI）、MiniMax因市场担忧先进芯片获取受限而大跌，数据中心供应商中际旭创、新易盛亦重挫；阿里巴巴跌3.46%，联想跌6.33%，百度跌3.39%。RTTNews称，有报道指OpenAI支持美国国会两党限制中国获取先进AI芯片及设备的提案，也压制了A股情绪。

- 美元升至约19个月高位，美国2年期国债收益率升至4.867%，10年期一度触及5.1169%，市场押注美联储下月加息。
- 日元兑美元9月以来首次跌破160，日本当局警告可能干预；日经全周涨6.46%。
- 韩国综合指数跌0.98%，SK海力士跌3.03%。
- 美国10月PPI将于北京时间今晚21:30公布。

来源：[RTHK](https://news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1877702-20261113.htm)、[RTTNews](https://www.finanzen.ch/nachrichten/aktien/asian-shares-slide-on-inflation-concerns-mounting-fed-tightening-bets-1036760879)、[联合早报](https://www.zaobao.com.sg/en/finance/singapore/asian-stocks-mostly-fall-inflation-fuels-rate-hike-expectations-sti-drops-nearly-1)。
body.en:
In Hong Kong, AI model stocks Z.AI and MiniMax fell sharply on worries about access to advanced chips, and data-centre suppliers Zhongji Innolight and Eoptolink slumped; Alibaba lost 3.46%, Lenovo 6.33% and Baidu 3.39%. RTTNews said reports that OpenAI backs a bipartisan push in Congress to curb China's access to advanced AI chips and tools also weighed on mainland shares.

- The dollar hit about a 19-month high; the U.S. 2-year yield rose to 4.867% and the 10-year touched 5.1169% as traders priced a possible Fed hike next month.
- The yen weakened past 160 per dollar for the first time since September, drawing intervention warnings; the Nikkei gained 6.46% on the week.
- Korea's Kospi fell 0.98%, with SK Hynix down 3.03%.
- U.S. October PPI is due at 8:30 a.m. ET (21:30 Beijing time).

Sources: [RTHK](https://news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1877702-20261113.htm), [RTTNews](https://www.finanzen.ch/nachrichten/aktien/asian-shares-slide-on-inflation-concerns-mounting-fed-tightening-bets-1036760879), [Lianhe Zaobao](https://www.zaobao.com.sg/en/finance/singapore/asian-stocks-mostly-fall-inflation-fuels-rate-hike-expectations-sti-drops-nearly-1).

title.zh: 日本动用6518亿日元预备费补贴冬季电费燃气费
title.en: Japan taps 651.8 billion yen in reserves to curb winter utility bills

summary.zh: 高市早苗内阁周五决定，从2.5万亿日元应急预备费中动用6518亿日元（约41亿美元），用于降低冬季电费和燃气费，原因是中东紧张局势导致能源价格持续高企。
summary.en: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's cabinet decided Friday to draw 651.8 billion yen ($4.1 billion) from 2.5 trillion yen in emergency reserves to lower winter utility bills, as Middle East tensions keep energy prices high.

title.zh: 外交部：期待达成APEC领导人深圳宣言，反对滥用出口管制
title.en: China hopes for APEC Shenzhen Declaration, opposes export-control abuse

summary.zh: 外交部发言人毛宁表示，下周APEC第三十三次领导人非正式会议将在深圳开幕，期待各方达成领导人深圳宣言；她同时称中方一贯反对滥用出口管制、扰乱全球产供链，中美应落实两国元首共识。
summary.en: Spokeswoman Mao Ning said China hopes next week's 33rd APEC leaders' meeting in Shenzhen yields a Shenzhen Declaration, and said Beijing opposes abuse of export controls that disrupts supply chains, urging the U.S. to implement the leaders' consensus.

body.zh:
外交部发言人毛宁13日在例行记者会上表示，今年是中国时隔12年再次担任APEC东道主，下周APEC第三十三次领导人非正式会议将在深圳拉开帷幕。中方期待各方进一步凝聚共识，达成领导人深圳宣言，在贸易、互联互通、数字经济和人工智能等领域取得更多务实成果。

- 在被问及美方收紧对华芯片出口时，毛宁表示，中方一贯反对滥用出口管制措施、扰乱全球产供链稳定，这不符合任何一方利益；中美双方应共同落实两国元首重要共识，维护经贸关系稳定。
- 对于中俄美三国元首会晤，毛宁称中方同相关方保持沟通，有进一步信息会及时发布。
- 据界面新闻，本届APEC领导人会议将实现100%绿电供应，电力来自广东阳江海上风电和西北沙戈荒风光基地。

来源：[界面新闻](https://www.jiemian.com/article/15188576.html)、[中国日报网](https://cn.chinadaily.com.cn/c/5bd54ba2a3101a87ca8ff5ee/5bd54bdea3101a87ca8ff5f0)。
body.en:
At Friday's briefing, Mao Ning noted that China is hosting APEC for the first time in 12 years and that the 33rd leaders' meeting opens in Shenzhen next week. Beijing hopes parties build consensus on a Leaders' Shenzhen Declaration with practical results on trade, connectivity, the digital economy and AI.

- Asked about U.S. moves to tighten chip exports, Mao said China opposes the abuse of export controls that disrupts global supply chains, which serves no one's interest, and that both sides should implement their leaders' consensus to keep trade ties stable.
- On a possible China-Russia-U.S. leaders' meeting, she said Beijing is in contact with the parties and will release information in due course.
- Jiemian reports the summit will run on 100% green power from offshore wind in Yangjiang, Guangdong, and desert wind and solar bases in the northwest.

Sources: [Jiemian](https://www.jiemian.com/article/15188576.html), [China Daily](https://cn.chinadaily.com.cn/c/5bd54ba2a3101a87ca8ff5ee/5bd54bdea3101a87ca8ff5f0).

title.zh: 2027年考研报名347万人，连降三年后小幅回升
title.en: 3.47 million sign up for China's 2027 graduate exam, first rise in four years

summary.zh: 教育部消息，2027年全国硕士研究生招生考试报名人数为347万，在连续三年下降后稍有回升。教育部已召开视频会议部署考试安全工作。
summary.en: China's Ministry of Education said 3.47 million people registered for the 2027 national master's entrance exam, a slight rebound after three straight annual declines. The ministry has held a meeting on exam security.

title.zh: 国务院安委会办公室约谈11个市级政府
title.en: State Council safety office summons 11 city governments over accidents

summary.zh: 国务院安委会办公室对11个发生重大事故或半年内发生3起以上较大事故的市级政府开展安全生产约谈，要求限期书面报告整改落实情况，整改不力、连续发生事故的将通报并抄送上一级监察机关。
summary.en: The State Council work-safety office summoned 11 city governments that had a major accident or three-plus serious ones in six months, ordering written reports on fixes; laggards with repeat accidents will be named and referred to higher supervisory bodies.
